raw:
Agent Name: Orchestrator
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: The Orchestrator failed to correctly interpret the search results from WebSurfer's initial Bing search. In step 4, WebSurfer reported finding a link to Ensembl (https://www.ensembl.org › Mus_musculus › Info › Index) in the search results, which was clearly a mistake by the search engine or a misinterpretation by WebSurfer, as the search was for beluga whales but the result showed Mus musculus (mouse). However, the Orchestrator did not catch this error and instead instructed WebSurfer to click on the "Ensembl" link, leading to a 404 error because the Ensembl link was for the wrong species. This was the first point where the Orchestrator failed to validate the relevance of the information provided by WebSurfer, setting the agents on a path of searching for the wrong species.
